repository.name: @webex/plugin-authorization-node
repository.purpose: Node authorization plugin registered as webex.authorization for Node builds (re-exported by the @webex/plugin-authorization Node entry, which webex-node and webex require, and imported directly by @webex/webex-server). It exchanges an OAuth authorization code at the identity broker token endpoint with the confidential client id and secret and maps HTTP 400 responses to grant errors, exchanges a host JWT for an access token through hydra jwt/login, mints HS256 guest JWTs, and posts a logout request without awaiting it. It performs no CSRF or state check and stores no tokens itself.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-authorization-node package entry
public_interfaces.audience: the @webex/plugin-authorization Node entry, webex-node, webex in Node, @webex/webex-server, and Node applications
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers Authorization as public plugin 'authorization' with proxies isAuthorizing and isAuthenticating and the empty credentials config. The first registration of the name wins.

public_interfaces.name: webex.authorization runtime methods
public_interfaces.audience: Node applications, webex-core credentials (JWT-mode refresh), and WebexCore#logout
public_interfaces.notes: requestAuthorizationCodeGrant sends the confidential client id and secret as Basic credentials and maps HTTP 400 to grant errors. oneFlight is keyed by method name, so concurrent calls with different arguments share the first result. logout returns undefined without awaiting its request.

public_interfaces.name: credentials configuration read by the plugin
public_interfaces.audience: integrators configuring Webex.init and webex-core credentials
public_interfaces.notes: The plugin namespace is Credentials, so it reads the shared credentials configuration owned by webex-core. src/config.js contributes {credentials: {}}. service is not declared by CredentialsConfig and is undefined unless the host sets it.

public_interfaces.notes: Run build:src before test:unit because the unit spec imports the package by name and loads dist. test:integration needs live services and test-user credentials. test:browser runs under karma where every nodeOnly suite is skipped, so it verifies no behavior. test:style does not lint src/authorization.js because the shared lint config ignores that file name.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not drop the Basic client credentials or shouldRefreshAccessToken false from the code grant.
negative_guidance.why: The confidential client authenticates with its secret, and a failing grant must not recurse into access-token refresh.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not store tokens in this package.
negative_guidance.why: Every token goes to webex.credentials.set({supertoken}); credentials owns storage, scheduling, and refresh.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not rename requestAccessTokenFromJwt, change its {jwt} argument, or remove its oneFlight decorator.
negative_guidance.why: webex-core credentials calls it during JWT-mode refresh.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not read a credentials key that CredentialsConfig does not declare.
negative_guidance.why: An undeclared key is silently undefined; logout's config.service is the existing example.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md or NODE-OAUTH-FLOW-GUIDE.md as the method, event, error, or refresh reference.
negative_guidance.why: Several claims differ from code or describe webex-core and host behavior; see docs/adr/0001-keep-existing-docs-separate.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not run test:unit against a stale dist.
negative_guidance.why: The unit spec imports the package by name, which resolves main (dist/index.js).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config sets no threshold.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec/authorization.js.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration, the HTTP 400 grant-error mapping, requestAccessTokenFromJwt, createJwt, or logout. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
